questions.stem: Which type of plants have fibrous roots and parallel venation?
questions.solution: Monocotyledonous plants have fibrous roots and parallel venation, which is a defining characteristic of this group. Dicotyledonous plants typically have taproots and reticulate venation, while climbers and creepers refer to growth habits, not root or venation patterns.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of dicotyledonous plants?
choices: They have parallel venation in leaves
They have a single seed leaf
questions.solution: Dicotyledonous plants are characterized by having a taproot system, which consists of a main root with smaller lateral roots. Fibrous roots and parallel venation in leaves are features of monocots, not dicots. A single seed leaf is also a trait of monocots, making it incorrect for dicots.

mr.solution: द्विबीजपत्री पौध्यांची ओळख एकाधिक रोमकेंद्र असणे ही आहे, जे मुख्य रोमाच्या बरोबर लहान बाजूच्या रोमांचे बनलेले असते. बर्याच रोमकेंद्र आणि पानांमध्ये समांतर शिरेसंच हे एकबीजपत्री पौध्यांचे वैशिष्ट्य आहेत, न की द्विबीजपत्री. एक बीजपत्र देखील एकबीजपत्री पौध्यांचे वैशिष्ट्य आहे, त्यामुळे ते द्विबीजपत्री पौध्यांसाठी अयोग्य आहे.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of monocotyledonous plants?
choices: They have a single seed leaf
questions.solution: Monocotyledonous plants are defined by having a single seed leaf, which distinguishes them from dicots that have two. Reticulate venation and taproot systems are characteristics of dicots, while fibrous roots are more common in monocots but not the defining feature. The presence of a single seed leaf is the key identifying trait.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an amphibian?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Frog' because frogs are animals that live both in water and on land and have a life cycle that includes metamorphosis. Swans are birds, fish are aquatic animals with gills, and wild buffalo are mammals that live on land.

questions.stem: Which of the following plants is most likely to have a taproot system?
questions.solution: Banyan is a tree that typically has a taproot system, which consists of a single, large primary root that grows downward and gives rise to smaller secondary roots. This type of root system provides strong anchorage and is common in many trees. Wheat, rice, and corn are monocots, which generally have fibrous root systems composed of many thin, equally sized roots rather than a single dominant taproot.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पौधा एक प्रमुख मूल प्रणाली के होने की संभावना अधिक है?
hi.solution: बरगद एक पेड़ है जिसके पास आमतौर पर प्रमुख मूल प्रणाली होती है, जिसमें एक बड़ी प्राथमिक मूल होती है जो नीचे की ओर बढ़ती है और छोटी द्वितीयक मूलों का उत्पादन करती है। इस प्रकार की मूल प्रणाली मजबूत बंधन प्रदान करती है और बहुत सारे पेड़ों में सामान्य होती है। गेहूँ, चावल और मक्का एकलबीजपत्री होते हैं, जिनके पास बहुत सारे पतले, बराबर आकार के मूल होते हैं, जिनके बजाय एक बड़ा प्रमुख मूल नहीं होता।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English content with appropriate botanical terminology used in Indian textbooks.

questions.stem: If a plant has a taproot, what can you infer about the plant?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'It is a dicot' because plants with taproots typically have two cotyledons in their seeds, which is a defining feature of dicots. Monocots, shrubs, and herbs do not specifically have taproots as a defining characteristic.

questions.stem: What would happen to a plant if it had a fibrous root system?

questions.stem: Which of the following groups of organisms is most likely to be found in a snowy region?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Snowy region plants and bears' because bears and plants adapted to cold environments are specifically suited to survive in snowy regions. Desert plants and camels are adapted to hot, dry conditions, tropical plants and birds thrive in warm, humid climates, and aquatic plants and fish are suited to water environments, not snowy areas.

questions.stem: A student observes a plant with parallel venation and fibrous roots. What can they conclude about the plant?
questions.solution: Plants with parallel venation and fibrous roots are typically monocots, as these are defining characteristics of that group. Dicots usually have reticulate venation and taproots, which are not present here. Gymnosperms and ferns do not have the same vascular structures as flowering plants, making them unlikely classifications.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains why plants from snowy regions cannot survive in a desert?
choices: They are not adapted to the high temperatures in a desert
They need more water than a desert provides
They are not able to grow in sandy soil
They are not able to reproduce in a desert
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'They are not adapted to the high temperatures in a desert' because plants from snowy regions have evolved to function in cold environments, and their biological processes are not suited for the extreme heat of a desert. Other options, such as water or soil requirements, may be true but are not the primary reason for their inability to survive in a desert, as the main issue is their lack of thermal adaptation.

questions.stem: A plant has a taproot system and reticulate venation. Which of the following is most likely to be true about this plant?

It has a fibrous root system
